text.autoconfig.gibbed.title: Gibbed Config
text.autoconfig.gibbed.option.GENERAL.pl: Percent chance on death for a player to be gibbed
text.autoconfig.gibbed.option.GENERAL.en: Percent chance on death for an entity to be gibbed
text.autoconfig.gibbed.option.GENERAL.pe: Percent chance per gib to be spawned when an entity is already being gibbed (Minimum 1 gib will always spawn)
text.autoconfig.gibbed.option.GENERAL.ex: If death by explosion should override gib chance and always gib
If death by explosion should override per gib spawn chance and spawn all gibs
text.autoconfig.gibbed.option.GENERAL.en: Blacklist of Entity Registry Names to blacklist from gibbing, modid:* blacklists all entities from a mod
Sets the Entity Gib Blacklist to instead act as a whitelist
text.autoconfig.gibbed.option.GENERAL.ma: Maximum amount of dying entities allowed to be queued at one time
text.autoconfig.gibbed.option.PHYSICS.gi: Total lifetime of gibs in ticks
Lifetime of gibs in ticks once idle on the ground
Multiplier to apply to gib collision box width to reduce collisions/size
If gibs should be able to push gibs on the ground
text.autoconfig.gibbed.option.PHYSICS.pl: If players should be able to push gibs on the ground
text.autoconfig.gibbed.option.PHYSICS.en: If other entities should be able to push gibs on the ground
text.autoconfig.gibbed.option.MODELS.onl: Will only gib entities that have had their rendering context captured
Rendering context includes specific scaling of parts and status of optionally rendered parts such as saddles
If disabled, entities that use a custom renderer may be able to be gibbed, however with some visual oddities
text.autoconfig.gibbed.option.MODELS.max: Limits the largest model branch size by area ratio to total model area that can be retained as a single gib
Lower values will result in more separated gibs, setting to 0 will result in a gib for each model part
Limits the combined model branch sizes by area ratio to total model area
Lower values will limit how many branches can be retained resulting in more separated gibs, setting to 0 will result in a gib for each model part
text.autoconfig.gibbed.option.MODELS.mod: Allows for overriding Max Branch Size Ratio and Max Branches Ratio per Entity Registry Name
Format: Entity Registry Name, Max Branch Size Ratio, Max Branches Ratio
text.autoconfig.gibbed.option.TEXTURES.u: Instead of rendering gibs using the original entity textures, a custom gore texture will be applied
text.autoconfig.gibbed.option.TEXTURES.e: If Use Gore Textures is enabled, entities in this list will still have their gibs rendered with the original entity texture
Entity Gore Texture Blacklist is Whitelist
Sets the Entity Gore Texture Blacklist to instead act as a whitelist
Blacklist of Entity Registry Names to blacklist from applying captured layer overlay textures to gibs
text.autoconfig.gibbed.option.TEXTURES.l: Entity Layered Texture Blacklist is Whitelist
Sets the Entity Layered Texture Blacklist to instead act as a whitelist
text.autoconfig.gibbed.option.SOUNDS.pla: A custom sound will be played when an entity is gibbed
text.autoconfig.gibbed.option.SOUNDS.gib: Volume to use when playing a sound from an entity being gibbed
Pitch to use when playing a sound from an entity being gibbed
text.autoconfig.gibbed.option.SOUNDS.pla: A custom sound will be played when a gib hits the ground
text.autoconfig.gibbed.option.SOUNDS.gib: Volume to use when playing a sound from a gib hitting the ground
Pitch to use when playing a sound from a gib hitting the ground
Spawns blood particles from gibs when an entity is gibbed
Spawns blood particles from gibs when they hit the ground
Scales the amount of particles attempted to be created based on the entities max health and amount of gibs created
